findings.claim: BWXT 獲選於 Fort Campbell 部署 20MW 微型反應爐（Army Janus），報導稱公司轉向 vendor-owned 營運模式、直接向設施售電
findings.source: MarketBeat: BWX Technologies army reactor win could redraw its nuclear growth story
findings.excerpt: BWX Technologies was selected to deploy a 20-megawatt electric BANR microreactor at Fort Campbell under the Army’s Janus program. The Army program helps validate BWX Technologies’ commercial microreactor strategy while shifting some early deployment risk into a milestone-based federal framework.
